Wrote `index.md` with cover. Synthesis pulls four cross-cutting threads beyond the per-child summaries:

1. The "walking distance" premise breaks — taxi pre-booking becomes the load-bearing constraint
2. Narbasu is the only Manzano-recommended sleep, but its Thu–Sun operating window constrains a Sun-night extension
3. The lodging villages (Cereceda, Cofiño, La Goleta, Peruyes, Caravia) are sleeping bases, not day-trip destinations — the activities sub-topic's Sella/Covadonga/Tito Bustillo set is the real itinerary
4. **Honesty about the gap:** the brief's "verified dinner mechanics feeding every sub-topic" was not researched in any child — flagged as the outstanding pre-trip phone call

Decisive booking-relevant 2026 facts (CO-4 Lakes shuttle Jun 1–Oct 18, Tito Bustillo tickets on sale Apr 1, book dinner before hotel) carried into the synthesis with original-source citations.
